tagline: Indonesian outdoor and rattan furniture, sourced and shipped FOB Jakarta for retailers and hotels across Asia-Pacific, Europe and North America

commerce.moq: Orders ship in 20 ft or 40 ft containers, depending on volume
commerce.paymentTerms: Bank transfer against a proforma invoice: 50% deposit to start production, balance before the container leaves Jakarta. Documents are couriered by air once the vessel has sailed
commerce.leadTime: Production about 3–4 weeks per shipment, plus ocean transit — about 1–2 weeks within Asia-Pacific, 4–6 weeks to Europe and North America

credentials.label: Third-party inspection welcome
